SC-2025-S136.title: Dismissal of pending gun possession charges
SC-2025-S136.summary: AN ACT TO AMEND THE SOUTH CAROLINA CODE OF LAWS BY AMENDING SECTION 17-1-65, RELATING TO THE EXPUNGEMENT OF CONVICTIONS FOR THE UNLAWFUL POSSESSION OF HANDGUNS, SO AS TO PROVIDE THE STATE MUST DISMISS AND EXPUNGE CERTAIN PENDING UNLAWFUL HANDGUN POSSESSION CHARGES THAT OCCURRED PRIOR TO THE ENACTMENT OF THE SOUTH CAROLINA CONSTITUTIONAL CARRY/SECOND AMENDMENT PRESERVATION ACT OF 2024, AND TO PROVIDE THE DISMISSAL OF THESE CHARGES MAY NOT SERVE AS A BASIS OR SUPPORT FOR CIVIL ACTIONS DUE TO THE ARREST. - RATIFIED TITLE
SC-2025-S136.summarySource: South Carolina legislature, description (via Open States)

Unanimous consent for third reading on next legislative day
Committee report: Favorable with amendment Judiciary

SC-2025-S136.aiSummary: The law requires the state to dismiss and expunge certain pending unlawful handgun possession charges that happened before the South Carolina Constitutional Carry/Second Amendment Preservation Act of 2024. It affects people with those pending gun possession cases. The dismissal of those charges cannot be used as a reason for civil lawsuits tied to the arrest.

SC-2025-H5811.title: DNR
SC-2025-H5811.summary: A HOUSE RESOLUTION TO AFFIRM THE SUPPORT OF THE SOUTH CAROLINA HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES FOR THE LAWFUL AND RESPONSIBLE TRADITION OF HUNTING DEER WITH DOGS; TO RECOGNIZE AND SUPPORT THE RIGHTS OF PRIVATE PROPERTY OWNERS; TO DECLARE THAT MATERIAL CHANGES TO THE LAWS GOVERNING THE PURSUIT OF DEER WITH DOGS ON PRIVATE PROPERTY ARE MATTERS FOR THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY; AND TO CALL UPON THE NATURAL RESOURCES BOARD TO RESPECT THE POLICY CHOICES ENACTED BY THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY.
SC-2025-H5811.summarySource: South Carolina legislature, description (via Open States)
SC-2025-H5811.aiSummary: This resolution says the South Carolina House supports hunting deer with dogs when done lawfully and responsibly. It also says private property owners’ rights should be respected, and that major changes to the rules for hunting deer with dogs on private land should be made by the General Assembly. It calls on the Natural Resources Board to follow the policy choices made by lawmakers.
